name: Dracena (Brazil)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and green with a red triangle at the hoist reaching the centre of the yellow stripe, bearing three white stars.
history: Dracena is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. Flags of the World quotes the municipal ordinance: the field is divided into three equal stripes, the outer ones green and the central one golden yellow, with a red triangle at the hoist bearing three white five-pointed stars.

features.role: triangle at the hoist reaching the centre
